results.why: K38 scores whether the abstract delivers a concretely available, reusable artifact (dataset/model/tool) versus a vague or absent release, which is the same open-artifact-provision property as T01, though it says nothing about links/versioning instructions.

No candidate scores the composite discussion property (interpretation against objectives/prior theory, alternative explanations, restrained conclusions, implications); K56/K49/K60 each touch only a fragment.
Nothing in the candidate bank scores TIDieR-style intervention/comparator description (dose, delivery, provider, co-interventions).

K46/K56/K01 score how well claims are anchored in named benchmarks and numbers, not whether primary/secondary outcome measures are defined, prioritized, and reported with uncertainty; the overlap is partial, not substitutable.

K17 (and K50's operational half) scores exactly whether variation across seeds/runs/checkpoints is measured and reported versus conclusions resting on a single unreplicated run, which is T05's randomness-control-and-repeats property in ML register.
No candidate scores documentation richness, intended-use limits, versioning, or stewardship; K26 shares the dataset topic but scores diagnostic design quality, a different property.
K38's construct — an accessible, concretely scoped artifact that others can actually reuse, versus a vague or promised release — is the same availability-and-reusability property T07 scores.
No candidate scores venue/aims fit or baseline submission eligibility.

K04 scores whether the contribution is stated as a specific difference from the nearest named prior method rather than an undifferentiated field, which is T09's novelty-contrasted-with-prior-work property, though K04 does not separately weigh how original the contribution is.
The bank has no criterion for procedural/analytical detail (controls, preprocessing, exclusion rules) sufficient for independent replication; artifact-release criteria score a different thing.
No candidate scores ethics approvals, data provenance/PII, compensation, or conflicts of interest; K22/K23 use human judgments as evaluation data, not as an ethics-transparency check.
No candidate scores length, concision, or format fit; K05 explicitly declines to penalize length and K18/K53 score narrative coherence instead.

K20 scores the claimed scope against the evidenced scope — penalizing universal claims backed by one task family — which is T13's external-validity/over-generalization property, distinct from candidates that score how broadly the method was actually tested.
No candidate concerns TRIPOD-style prediction-model reporting (calibration/discrimination, development vs validation study type).

No candidate scores statistical appropriateness, assumption checks, multiplicity control, or power; K17 covers only the seed-variation/uncertainty fragment and K55 scores whether measurement validity is the paper's contribution.

K04 scores situating the contribution against a named nearest prior method and K58 scores the quantified comparison against a named strong baseline, together the same positioning-and-comparison-to-prior-work property T16 describes.
